view_ridge_dadu.heading: DADU Project in View Ridge with Butterfly Roof
view_ridge_dadu.text1: This View Ridge project combines three useful elements in one compact backyard build: a DADU, a custom deck, and a shed built beneath the deck. The design shows how careful planning can create a complete living environment without wasting a small footprint. The DADU also has a unique butterfly roof design, with a valley in the middle of the roof.
view_ridge_dadu.text2: The DADU includes a full-size refrigerator and dishwasher, an apartment-size range, a large kitchen window, open shelving, cabinets made of rift oak, custom under-stair cabinetry, and two made-to-fit Murphy beds: one vertical and one horizontal. Those flexible sleeping solutions allow rooms to serve as offices, exercise areas, or guest rooms when the beds are closed.
view_ridge_dadu.short2: DADU Project in View Ridge with Butterfly Roof
view_ridge_dadu.text3: Explore how site planning, compact-space design, custom carpentry, and flexible rooms came together in this backyard DADU.

part1.small_heading: Detached DADU with deck and shed integration
part1.text2: This project was not only a detached backyard living unit. It also included a custom deck with a shed built underneath it, giving the site layered functionality and better use of the available footprint. This layered scope added another level of construction coordination beyond a standard DADU build.
part1.text3: The elevated deck, the enclosed storage below it, and the surrounding stairs work together as one outdoor area.

part2.small_heading: Kitchen planning in a small footprint
part2.text2: The kitchen is one of the best features of the DADU. Even in a compact room, the layout fits a standard-size refrigerator, dishwasher, and an apartment-size range. A large window, generous natural light, and open shelving on both sides keep the compact kitchen bright and practical.
part2.text3: Every inch of this small footprint was put to use, so the compact kitchen packs a lot of punch.

part3.text2: This project includes several carpentry details worth noting. Built-in cabinetry under the staircase includes a custom triangular storage door and matching trim detail. These are small but highly visible touches that make the interior feel custom rather than generic.
part3.text3: Every available area was used for function, which is especially important in a compact detached dwelling.

part4.small_heading: Vertical Murphy bed for flexible living
part4.text2: One of the standout custom features is the first Murphy bed, built in a vertical configuration. It folds into the wall so the room can shift between sleeping space and open floor area. This type of space-saving furniture is especially valuable in a smaller DADU where every room may need to serve more than one purpose.
part4.text3: Silver Peak built the Murphy beds for this project, creating a tailored solution instead of relying on standard cabinetry or prefabricated storage.

part5.small_heading: Horizontal Murphy bed and office / guest room flexibility
part5.text2: The second Murphy bed is even more distinctive. It was custom made as a horizontal Murphy bed to fit the client’s room layout and specifications. Its unusual orientation makes it a memorable example of custom problem solving for a tight room layout.
part5.text3: Most of the year, that room works as a clean, functional office. When guests visit, the bed folds down and the space becomes a guest bedroom. It shows how the project delivers flexible living without wasting square footage.

part6.small_heading: Exterior character and compact bathroom design
part6.text2: The overall exterior composition, new concrete stairs, and tall entry sequence give the DADU a unique architectural presence.
part6.text3: Inside, Silver Peak designed a three-quarter bath upstairs and a powder room downstairs, so even the smallest spaces feel complete and usable.
